clips.speaker: luis
clips.text: I am always busy, but I am not always productive. Today I have six tasks and two hours. What is my priority?

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Priority. My priority is the report.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Task. This task takes ten minutes.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Urgent. This message is urgent.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Productive. I am productive in the morning.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Schedule. My schedule is full on Monday.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Break. I take a break at twelve.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Focus. I focus best in the morning.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Routine. My morning routine is simple.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Marco drives a truck. He usually starts at six. He never skips a break, and his priority is the delivery list. Priya works in an office. She often answers emails first, but her priority is the report. Luis supervises a team. He sometimes works late. He focuses best in the morning, so the urgent tasks come first.

clips.speaker: mia
clips.text: Tom, you look busy. What does your day look like?

clips.speaker: tom
clips.text: I usually start at seven. First I check my emails, but they take too much time.

clips.speaker: mia
clips.text: What is your priority today?

clips.speaker: tom
clips.text: My priority is the delivery report. It is urgent, so I focus on it before lunch.

clips.speaker: mia
clips.text: Do you take a break?

clips.speaker: tom
clips.text: Yes, I do. I always take a short break at twelve. Then I feel better and I work faster.

clips.speaker: mia
clips.text: That sounds like a productive day.

clips.speaker: tom
clips.text: I try. And you, Mia? When do you focus best?

clips.speaker: tom
clips.text: On a busy day, my top three is clear. First, the delivery report, because it is urgent. Second, a short break, because it helps me focus. Third, planning tomorrow. I usually answer emails later.

clips.speaker: mia
clips.text: It is nine at night. My boss sends me a message. I am at home with my family. What do I do?

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Available. I am available after five.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Reply. I usually reply in the morning.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Message. I get many messages at work.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Call. I sometimes ignore calls at night.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Late. It is late, so I reply tomorrow.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Personal time. Sunday is my personal time.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Urgent. An urgent message needs an answer now.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Boundary. My boundary is no email after eight.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Message one, from Mom, at seven p.m.: Dinner on Sunday? Reply when you can. Message two, from your boss, at eight fifty-five p.m.: The truck is late. Please call me now. Message three, from a client, at two p.m.: Please send the price list today. Message four, from a friend, at eleven thirty p.m.: Look at this funny video! Message five, from a neighbor, at six forty-five a.m.: Your car lights are on. Message six, from a group chat, at ten a.m.: Who has the meeting notes?

clips.speaker: mia
clips.text: Tom, your phone is on again. Do you always answer messages at night?

clips.speaker: tom
clips.text: No, I don’t. I usually reply in the morning, because the evening is my personal time.

clips.speaker: mia
clips.text: But what about urgent messages?

clips.speaker: tom
clips.text: That is different. My boss sometimes calls with a real problem. Then I answer.

clips.speaker: mia
clips.text: And messages from friends?

clips.speaker: tom
clips.text: I can reply later. Nobody needs an answer at eleven p.m.

clips.speaker: mia
clips.text: That sounds like a good boundary.

clips.speaker: tom
clips.text: Yes. I am available for urgent things, but not for everything.

clips.speaker: mia
clips.text: My boss writes at nine p.m. The truck is late. It is urgent, so I answer now. Then my boss has the information. A friend writes at midnight. It is not urgent, so I reply tomorrow. Then I sleep well.
